limitations: Known-normal sample planning assumes genuinely known population variance; pilot substitution is explicitly only planning. Neither check establishes these assumptions for service data.

Hierarchical percentile intervals remain conditional approximations. The implemented resampling checks cover a restricted paired two-level model rather than all described hierarchy variants or statistical coverage.

test_assessment: The old source checks the paired two-level bootstrap distribution using ordered plans versus a separate exact rational occupancy/multinomial reference, pairing invariants, denominator failure paths and independent numerical examples. It does not establish confidence coverage. The new source checks precision through rational inequalities, detection sample size through model power and minimality, and strict zero-exceedance boundaries through a separate sequential rational search. Complete bit-sequence enumeration and surviving-state dynamic programming agree with direct intersection counts for 13/256 and 215/16384. Protocol cases distinguish all gates from any gate and require final confirmation. Some controls expose wrong arithmetic directly rather than executing an entire alternative protocol. Supplied preflight execution supports these finite models, without proving real-service independence, bootstrap validity or causal knowledge benefit.
